automated.summary: SETUPRACE-1 recoverable atomic claim for setup-pause notifications. markJobSetupNotified is an atomic CAS that claims when the fingerprint differs or an existing claim is stale (notify_claim_at past a TTL) and returns the claim timestamp as an ownership token; notifyJobSetupRequired claims before sending (loser sends nothing), confirms on delivery / clears on failure, each fenced by notify_claim_at=token so a stale claimant cannot touch a successor's claim; notify_claim_at is plumbed through canonical parse/serialize; the delivery view clears notified_fingerprint so the card sender doesn't treat a pending claim as delivered; the detached creation notify routes by the reloaded job's session. Full verify.py green; runner+application+jobs suites 2053 passing.

setup-pause-prompt.test.ts + job-permission-recovery.test.ts: claim->(confirm|clear) contract with the ownership token.

remaining_gaps: Delivery is exactly-once under normal operation and at-least-once across two abnormal windows (a post-send crash before confirm; a delivery hanging past the claim TTL) — an accepted fundamental limit (true exactly-once needs a durable idempotent outbox / send-cancellation, disproportionate for a setup card), documented in 0117 + code.
